title: VIDA: A Dataset for Visually Dependent Ambiguity in Multimodal Machine Translation
abstract: arXiv:2605.02035v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ambiguity resolution is a key challenge in multimodal machine translation (MMT), where models must genuinely leverage visual input to map an ambiguous expression to its intended meaning. Although prior work has proposed disambiguation-oriented benchmarks probing the role of vision, we observe that existing benchmarks remain limited by task-format mismatch, narrow ambiguity coverage, or insufficient visual-dependency validation. Moreover, existing ambiguity evaluations are not well suited to diverse ambiguity types in open-ended translation. To address these limitations, we present VIDA (Visually-Dependent Ambiguity), a dataset of 2,500 carefully curated instances in which resolving an annotated source span requires visual evidence. We further propose Disambiguation-Centric Metrics that use an LLM-as-a-judge classifier to verify whether annotated ambiguous expressions are resolved correctly at the span level. Evaluations with st

translated_title: VIDA：一个面向多模态机器翻译中视觉依赖歧义的数据集
translated_abstract: 歧义消解是多模态机器翻译（MMT）中的一项关键挑战，模型必须真正利用视觉输入，将歧义表达映射到其预期含义。尽管先前的工作已提出了一些面向消歧的基准来探究视觉的作用，但我们观察到，现有基准仍然受限于任务格式不匹配、歧义类型覆盖范围狭窄，或视觉依赖性验证不足等问题。此外，现有的歧义评估方法并不适用于开放式翻译中多样化的歧义类型。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了VIDA（视觉依赖歧义）数据集，其中包含2,500个精心筛选的实例，在这些实例中，解析被标注的源语言片段需要依赖视觉证据。我们进一步提出了以消歧为中心的评估指标（Disambiguation-Centric Metrics），利用LLM作为裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）的分类器来验证被标注的歧义表达是否在片段级别被正确消解。（注：原摘要在此处截断，评估实验部分的描述不完整）
tldr: 提出了VIDA数据集，包含2,500个必须依赖视觉证据才能消解歧义的翻译实例，并配套提出基于LLM裁判的片段级消歧评估指标，弥补了现有多模态机器翻译歧义基准的不足。
en_tdlr: VIDA introduces a dataset of 2,500 curated instances where resolving ambiguous source spans requires visual evidence, along with Disambiguation-Centric Metrics that use an LLM-as-a-judge classifier to verify span-level disambiguation in multimodal machine translation.
